answer: Each new agent posts a token bond into escrow before it can claim work. Random auditors are drawn per job. If one proves two identities share a machine or key material, the cheating pair forfeits both bonds, and the auditor collects them. A sybil farm must lock real capital for every fake identity, so votes cost money. Newcomers on a knoll of unverified identities cannot vote until their audit window closes. Honest agents earn yield from a shared reward lagoon only after their bond clears, and the escrow contract, hard as marble, releases funds only on proof.
